body_markdown:
If your hair feels a little less smooth, a little harder to detangle, or a little more prone to snapping than it used to, the real question is not “strengthening shampoo or bond repair?” It is


when does your hair need daily defence, and when does it need targeted repair?


The better long-term strategy is not to wait until damage is obvious. Make prevention your routine foundation, then add targeted bond repair when hair is already damaged or goes through repeated stress from colour, heat, chemical services, friction, or styling. Think of wash-day maintenance as your baseline, and repair treatment as the focused step you bring in when hair needs more support.


As the original bond builder, we look at this decision through bonds: the inner structure that helps hair feel strong, smooth, and resilient. Our Nº.4 BOND MAINTENANCE™ STRENGTHENING SHAMPOO is the everyday wash-day example; our Nº.3PLUS COMPLETE REPAIR TREATMENT is the targeted pre-shampoo repair example. When used as a system of Nº.3PLUS COMPLETE REPAIR TREATMENT, Nº.4 BOND MAINTENANCE™ STRENGTHENING SHAMPOO, and Nº.5 BOND MAINTENANCE™ STRENGTHENING CONDITIONER, the supported results are hair that is 90% smoother, better detangling, and more conditioned.\[2\]


## **Strengthening Shampoo vs Bond Repair: What Each Step Is For**


A strengthening shampoo belongs in the part of your routine you repeat most often: cleansing. The goal is to help hair feel cleaner, smoother, more hydrated, and more resilient without turning wash day into a full treatment session every time.


Bond repair has a different job. It is the step you reach for when hair already shows signs of damage or faces repeated stress. It is less about “just cleansing” and more about giving damaged hair a dedicated repair moment before you shampoo.


Here is the simplest way to choose.


**Your Need** **Strengthening Wash Care** **Targeted Bond Repair**


Timing


Regular wash days


Before shampoo, when hair needs extra repair support


Main goal


Cleanse while supporting strength, hydration, shine, and manageability


Repair existing damage and help defend against future damage


Best fit


Hair that is styled, coloured, or exposed to everyday stress but still needs a light, regular routine


Hair that feels brittle, rough, tangled, frizzy, or weakened after colour, bleach, heat, chemical services, or repeated styling


Limit


Shampoo should not be treated as a permanent fix for split ends or a substitute for targeted repair when damage is clear


A treatment is not your cleanser; it works as a focused step within a broader routine

Nº.3PLUS COMPLETE REPAIR TREATMENT


Our Nº.4 BOND MAINTENANCE™ STRENGTHENING SHAMPOO is a highly concentrated, sulphate-free shampoo for medium to coarse hair that gently cleanses while repairing everyday damage, strengthening and reinforcing bonds, replenishing hydration, and boosting shine in one wash.\[2\] It provides a reparative cleanse that does not weigh hair down, and is clinically proven to smooth and reduce frizz, reduce split ends, and boost shine.\[2\]


Our N°.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment is a 3-minute, protein-free pre-shampoo treatment that uses patented OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology™ and a Damage Defense Cationic Complex to repair all three hair bonds from cortex to cuticle, delivering softer, stronger hair and helping defend against future damage for all hair types.\[1\] It is clinically proven to create 3X softer hair and 3X stronger hair after 4 uses vs. bleached hair.\[1\]


## **How to Choose Your Routine Before and After Damage**


Start with what your hair is telling you. You do not need to wait for a dramatic before-and-after moment to make a smarter routine choice.


### **If your hair feels healthy but you heat-style often**


Keep your routine built around prevention. Repeated styling can be a source of stress, so your everyday wash care should do more than cleanse. Nº.4 is the regular maintenance step here: it repairs everyday damage in 1 wash, replenishes hydration, enhances softness, and strengthens and reinforces bonds for more resilient hair at a molecular level.\[2\]


This is the “don’t wait for the problem to announce itself” route. You are keeping the routine simple, but not passive.


### **If your hair is colour-treated or chemically serviced**


Make maintenance your foundation and consider targeted repair when hair starts to feel less smooth, less elastic, or harder to manage. Colour and chemical services can leave hair feeling more fragile, so the goal is to support the hair before visible damage becomes the only signal.


Nº.4 helps strengthen, hydrate, and boost shine so every wash day feels like you just left the salon.\[2\] If your hair needs a focused repair step, N°.3PLUS works before shampoo and is designed to repair all types of damage in all hair types.\[1\]


### **If your hair tangles, feels brittle, or looks rough**


This is where targeted repair earns its place. A shampoo can support a stronger-feeling routine, but hair that is already rough, brittle, or snagging may need more than a wash-day cleanse.


Use N°.3PLUS as the pre-shampoo repair step when hair needs more focused care. It immediately repairs hair damage for softer, stronger hair, improves manageability, infuses moisture, and helps restore a visibly healthy, smooth cuticle appearance after bleach when used as instructed.\[1\]


Then follow with Nº.4 to cleanse while supporting strength, hydration, and shine.\[2\]


### **If you see breakage or split ends**


Do not switch into “repair only” mode and abandon maintenance. Breakage and split ends are signs that your routine needs both: a consistent wash-day base and targeted repair support.


N°.3PLUS reduces future breakage for length retention over time and supports stronger internal hair structure over time, with 75% stronger internal hair structure reported.\[1\] Nº.4 is clinically proven to reduce split ends and repairs everyday damage while defending against future breakage.\[2\]


The practical move: keep wash care consistent, add repair where needed, and reduce avoidable stressors such as excessive heat or overlapping chemical services. Follow product directions so each step can do the job it was made to do.


## **Can One Routine Cover Both Prevention and Repair?**


Yes—when each product has a clear role. The mistake is treating prevention and repair as rivals.


For everyday cleansing, Nº.4 helps repair everyday damage, strengthen and reinforce bonds, replenish hydration, and boost shine in one wash.\[2\] For targeted repair, N°.3PLUS transforms damaged hair in just 3 minutes before shampooing and reverses damage in one use when used as instructed on packaging.\[1\]


Together, the routine becomes more strategic:


-


N°.3PLUS before shampoo


when hair needs a focused repair step.


-


Nº.4 during wash day


to cleanse while supporting strength, hydration, shine, smoothness, and manageability.


-


Nº.5 as part of the system


when you want the approved Nº.3PLUS, Nº.4, and Nº.5 performance benefits: less breakage, more hydration, and smoother, more conditioned hair.\[2\]


This is not about doing more for the sake of it. It is about putting the right step in the right place.


## **What We Mean by “Supported Claims”**


When we talk about our products, we keep the claim tied to the product, use condition, and result it belongs to. Our product pages support OLAPLEX product facts, usage, technology, and performance claims. General hair-damage education helps explain why prevention and repair both matter, but it should not be used to stretch a product claim beyond what the product itself supports.


That distinction matters. “Clinically proven to create 3X stronger hair after 4 uses vs. bleached hair” belongs to N°.3PLUS.\[1\] “Clinically proven to smooth and reduce frizz” belongs to Nº.4.\[2\] A system result, such as a 49% reduction in breakage when used as a system of Nº.3PLUS COMPLETE REPAIR TREATMENT, Nº.4 BOND MAINTENANCE™ STRENGTHENING SHAMPOO, and Nº.5 BOND MAINTENANCE™ STRENGTHENING CONDITIONER, belongs to that system—not to a single step used in isolation.\[1\]\[2\]


Clear claims make better routines. No guesswork, no overpromising—just the right evidence in the right place.


## **FAQ**


### **Can shampoo fix split ends?**


No—do not treat shampoo as a permanent fix for split ends. A strengthening shampoo can support smoother, stronger-feeling wash care, and our Nº.4 BOND MAINTENANCE™ STRENGTHENING SHAMPOO is clinically proven to reduce split ends, but visible splitting is still a sign to add more care rather than wait for damage to build.\[2\]


### **Is bond repair only for bleached hair?**


No. Our N°.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment is designed to repair all types of damage in all hair types.\[1\] Bleached hair appears in some of the clinical comparison language—for example, N°.3PLUS is clinically proven to create 3X softer and 3X stronger hair after 4 uses vs. bleached hair—but that does not mean bond repair is only for bleached hair.\[1\]


### **What signs mean I should add a repair treatment?**


Add a repair treatment when your hair feels brittle, rough, harder to detangle, more frizzy, or more prone to breakage. Those signs suggest your regular wash care may need support from a targeted step. N°.3PLUS is a pre-shampoo treatment that repairs all three hair bonds from cortex to cuticle, helps defend against future damage, and improves manageability while infusing moisture.\[1\]


### **Is protein the same as bond repair?**


No. In our routine, protein and bond repair are not the same thing. N°.3PLUS is a protein-free pre-shampoo treatment that uses patented OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology™ and a Damage Defense Cationic Complex to repair all three hair bonds from cortex to cuticle.\[1\]


## **The Better Choice Is a Smarter Sequence**


If your hair is already in good shape, use strengthening wash care as your steady foundation. If your hair is damaged, stressed, brittle, or breaking, do not wait—bring in targeted bond repair and keep your wash-day maintenance consistent.


That is the balanced answer: prevention first, repair when needed, and a routine that respects what each step can do. Start with the step your hair needs most today, then build from there with confidence.
